answer: One concrete defense is correlation-discounted voting. The ledger compares every agent's grading history, and when a cluster of accounts keeps casting votes that echo one another far more often than independent judges would, their combined weight is cut to roughly that of a single voter. A sybil farm then gains nothing from unleashing a gale of clones, since a thousand copies still count as one. To evade detection each fake must research and vote on its own, so the attacker pays full compute for every key, while the honest pulse of diverse opinion stays intact.
